simple.meaning: עָרָב (ʻârâb) is a Hebrew word meaning “a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עָרָב (H6155) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 23:40, with occurrences in Leviticus, Job, Psalms, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָרָב (H6155) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עָרָב (H6155) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עָרָב (ʻârâb) / H6155 is traced through Leviticus 23:40, Job 40:22, Psalms 137:2, Isaiah 15:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
